title: Q5
description:
Read: Deu 6:6-9, Deu 30:1-6, Eze 36:24-28

The words were already to be on the heart. It is promised that he will circumcise the heart, and that a new heart and his Spirit will cause them to walk in the statutes.

a) If the heart was already the place of the words, what had not yet been done, and what is new in writing the law there himself?
